Name: Subdivision
Description: Sets the number of grid divisions along each axis. Higher values create a denser grid with more cells.

Name: Line Intensity
Description: Controls the brightness or opacity of the main grid lines, making them more or less prominent in the texture.

Name: Sub Intensity
Description: Adjusts the brightness or opacity of the subdivision lines, which are the finer lines between main grid lines.

Name: Line Thickness
Description: Specifies the thickness of the grid lines. Higher values produce bolder, wider lines.
